messages:
zoe: customer onboarding blocked: their Metro bundler (react-native-desktop) can't resolve 'redwood-sdk' after upgrading to v6. sdk import fails with "Cannot find module".
rahim: did we remove the top-level main or require entry when we migrated to conditional exports? which version?
zoe: sdk@6.4.0. package.json exports are using wildcard subpaths for tree-shaking. no explicit "main" and no "require" condition, only import/default.
cleo: Metro and some older packagers don't honor conditional exports and expect a plain CJS main. electron/metro combos are common for some customers.
zoe: their app uses `require('redwood-sdk')` in an older RN-desktop module.
rahim: immediate fix: publish a 6.x patch adding a top-level "main": "dist/cjs/index.cjs" and expand exports with a `require` condition. also add a `types` top-level pointing at `dist/index.d.ts`.
cleo: TS side note: VSCode/tsserver sometimes can't find types because exports don't expose the bare import for TS resolution. we should add an explicit ".": { "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "import": "./esm/index.mjs", "require": "./cjs/index.cjs" }.
pack-bot: CI sample-matrix: metro-smoke (node14) failing - exit 1.
rahim: add a smoke test that runs `node -e "require('redwood-sdk')"` on node14 and an RN/metro mock resolver. Also add a vite+ts sample to catch TS resolution issues.
cleo: long-term: write a short packaging guide in devex explaining recommended package.json layout for libraries shipping ESM/CJS + types, and include a `typesVersions` fallback for older TS.
zoe: replying to customer: suggested workarounds: pin to v6.3.x or patch package.json locally adding "main" + "types", or upgrade bundler/node. shared PR link once ready.
rahim: opening PR redwood/sdk#501 - add cjs require fallback + types export + smoke tests. will include changelog note mentioning Metro/Electron compatibility.
cleo: also add a one-liner in quickstart README showing both `import` and `require` examples and compatibility note for older packagers.
zoe: thanks — assigning to rahim for the patch. :thumbsup:
pack-bot: PR pipeline started: redwood/sdk#501
